key_facts: Covers 8 major areas: CI/CD, Containers, IaC, Monitoring, K8s, Networking, Security, Disaster Recovery
Includes anti-patterns table at the end

data.for_supervisor: VERDICT: Created devops-patterns skill. Covers CI/CD (trunk-based dev, pipeline as code, deployment strategies, rollback), Containers (single process, multi-stage builds, layer optimization, health checks), IaC (immutable infra, state management, drift detection), Monitoring (three pillars, alerting, dashboards), Kubernetes (deployment best practices, autoscaling, secrets), Networking (ingress, service mesh), Security (defense in depth, supply chain, secrets scanning), and Disaster Recovery (backup strategy, incident response). Each pattern has when-to-use criteria, actionable rules, and an anti-patterns reference table.
